findings.claim: PATH is replaced wholesale with only the temp bin dir. Anything the opencode install path runs that resolves via PATH (git, sh, shell-outs) will now fail or behave differently; the stub scripts use #!/bin/sh with absolute interpreter so they work, but other lookups would not. Appending to or prefixing the existing PATH would keep the memorycard/codegraph isolation only if the real machine lacks them, so the trade-off is a latent fragility rather than a proven failure.

The stub-binary setup is inlined in opencodeInstall with a magic list of program names; if the install code later checks additional MCP programs, goldens will silently record them as missing. Also the Windows case (no exec bit/.exe lookup) is not handled, though the repo is Linux-focused.

evidence: Single changed file reviewed from the diff only; the PATH replacement via t.Setenv is restored automatically at test end.
w.name(bin, "<BIN>") registers the temp dir for transcript normalization, so goldens stay stable across runs.
